summary: Wrote an 8-phase hard-mode plan that explicitly owns the mandatory scope expansion beyond the task title. The plan covers all three research-verified defects: D1 (land lemma4_7_ii, correct the module docstring's false '(i) and (ii) are the same formula' claim), D2 (repair InputCtx.outputPruning to ctx.Gamma' ++ (ctx.Lambda.headD NestedLhs.empty :: ctx.Lambda.tail), which is what makes nested_sound_impL true rather than refutable), and D3 (land nested_sound_cut plus the missing .cut arm, which is what takes lake build from RED to green). Every phase is one bounded agent run (~40-90 lines) with a concrete runnable verification command and a stated expected result. Because the baseline is RED, each phase that touches Soundness.lean verifies against a NAMED expected residual error ('Missing cases: _, (NestedProof.cut ...)' and, until Phase 5, the sorry warning) rather than a clean build, and states that any additional diagnostic is that phase's own fallout. Genuine intermediate green checkpoints land at Phase 2 (Context/Rules/Translation all build green - this is also the D2 blast-radius test) and Phase 6 (Translation green). The build flips to green at Phase 7, which is as early as is honest since cut's proof consumes the repaired impL. All 11 research-compiled declarations are assigned explicit landing sites in a Preserved Assets table with a MUST-NOT-re-derive rule. PLAN-TIME REFINEMENT to the research report, verified by reading Context.lean:100-190: the report's claim that Translation.lean:300 'collapses to reflexivity' under the D2 repair holds only for non-empty ctx.Gamma'. At Gamma' = [] the two sides are (empty, box empty pi) versus (empty, pi) - still one box apart - so the tBox/cs5DerivTopImpElim machinery must be RETAINED and the proof restructured as a two-case split on Gamma'. This is recorded as a binding Do-NOT so the implementer does not delete live machinery.

Phase 2's three-module build gate is the real test, and the plan instructs the implementer to STOP and report rather than widen scope if fallout appears outside the declared file scope.

Phase 8 attempts it, records the outcome truthfully, and substitutes lake exe mk_all --check plus lake build's weak.linter.style.* options. The plan forbids reporting the invariant as met by a command that did not run.
